nfl.success_rate.rationale: NEWS need is spurious: 'report the gap between epa rank and success-rate rank' is an output description, not a transaction/news feed. Success/early-down rate is built from nflverse pbp (down, distance, epa) only.

nfl.ratings.rationale: raw_data lists games.csv spread_line, total_line and home/away moneylines: the 'market-implied team strength' half is market-derived (nfl.schedule_results marks those columns as market data, excluded). Only the own-rating half (pbp EPA) is market-free, so the input is a hybrid, not fully computable market-free.
nfl.ratings.notes: market-implied component is a benchmark; own ratings component from pbp

nfl.roster_continuity.rationale: RULES ('shrinkage coefficient') and RECRUITING ('returning production') are spurious: NFL has no portal/recruiting. Real needs are roster snapshots (nfl.rosters 1999-2025) plus snap_counts (2012-2025) to measure turnover and returning snap share.

nfl.qb_efficiency.rationale: RULES need is spurious (matched the word 'coefficient'/'prior weight' in a shrinkage description). DRAFT need (draft-slot prior) is legitimate and stays on nfl.draft_combine (picks 1980+).

nfl.explosive.rationale: Explosive-play rate (10+ rush / 20+ pass yards, air-yards profile) is play-level; nfl.player_stats_weekly has only weekly player aggregates with no per-play yardage. Needs nfl.pbp (yards_gained, air_yards, 1999-2025).

nfl.redzone.rationale: Red-zone and goal-to-go TD rate, success rate and 4th-down go rate inside the 5 need play-level yardline_100/down from nfl.pbp; mapped dataset nfl.schedule_results (final scores, venue) cannot supply any of those fields.

nfl.fumble_luck.rationale: PROJECTIONS need is spurious: 'forward projections' describes shrinkage of the own estimate, not a published projection-system vintage (xx.projection_vintages). Fumble rate/recovery data come from nfl.pbp and weekly stats.

nfl.kicker.rationale: No kicking data is mapped: kicker accuracy by distance and kickoff touchback rate need nfl.pbp (kick_distance, field_goal_result, kicker ids, touchback) and weekly kicking stats; draft only mapped weather/venue/rules.

nfl.officials_crew.rationale: NEWS need is spurious/over-pessimistic: crew-to-game assignment is per-game data in nfl.officials/schedule_results (referee); the 'announced Thursday' remark is timing only. Penalty tendencies derive from pbp. Announcement timestamp is not stored, so PIT is coarse rather than unavailable.
nfl.officials_crew.notes: crew full-crew detail beyond referee not verified in schedule_results

nfl.pace.rationale: VENUE ('neutral-situation') and DRAFT ('combine offense and opponent defense') are keyword accidents. Pace/plays per game with win-prob filter needs only nfl.pbp (+ drive time of possession).

nfl.proe.rationale: WEATHER_FCST and VENUE are spurious: 'forecast attempts' and 'forecast score distribution' refer to the own model's output, not a weather forecast. Expected-pass model uses pbp features; coach/QB regime flags need schedule_results (coaches). Forecast score distribution is derived from own team model.

nfl.two_minute_tempo.rationale: DRAFT need is spurious ('combine' as a verb). Two-minute/hurry-up tempo needs only nfl.pbp clock/timeout/score fields.

nfl.garbage_time.rationale: DRAFT need is spurious ('combine into expected garbage mass'). Needs only nfl.pbp win-probability and score state.

nfl.q_scoring.rationale: DRAFT need is spurious ('combine team and opponent scoring shares'). Quarter/half scoring comes from nfl.pbp/schedule scores.

nfl.qb.rationale: Starting-QB status with 'timestamp each information vintage' needs timestamped injury-report vintages and game-day inactives plus depth charts; nfl.injuries_weekly is final-of-week only (no intra-week vintages) and SCHEME participation is spurious.
nfl.qb.notes: actual starter is known post hoc from pbp passer; pregame belief history requires vintages

nfl.injuries_pit.rationale: Definition is timestamped injury-report vintages by day; draft mapped nfl.injuries_weekly (one row per player-week, intra-week vintages not preserved) and spurious NEWS. Required dataset is nfl.injury_report_vintages (prospective capture only).

nfl.depth_chart_pit.rationale: Depth-chart vintages are directly available as nfl.depth_charts (weekly snapshots 2001-2025); draft mapped nfl.participation (per-play) plus spurious NEWS/SCHEME/AVAIL and so over-pessimistically called it prospective. Cadence is weekly, so PIT_COARSE.

nfl.inactives_pit.rationale: Game-day inactive list (~90 min pre-kick) is exactly nfl.inactives_game_day (prospective capture only); draft mapped participation and weekly injuries, neither of which holds pre-kick inactive lists.

nfl.ol.rationale: Missing lineup/start data: 'games started together by projected five' needs depth charts/snap counts and individual OL pressures allowed need PFR advanced stats (2018+); was_pressure from participation. None of LINEUP, PFR or SCHEME mapped.

nfl.in_game_exit_risk.rationale: NEWS need is spurious ('adjusted by injury report status'). In-game exit rate comes from snap_counts (snaps missed) plus weekly injury status.

nfl.pass_rush.rationale: Player-level pressures need PFR advanced stats (2018+) and team pressure needs participation was_pressure; nfl.player_stats_weekly has only sacks/QB hits.

nfl.cb_coverage_matchup.rationale: VENUE is spurious ('travel patterns' = defender travel). Primary coverage assignments are explicitly not public; the proxy needs participation/FTN route data and PFR targets-in-coverage, and true shadow assignment would need raw tracking (sample only).
nfl.cb_coverage_matchup.notes: shadow-coverage assignments not public; proxy only

nfl.run_defense.rationale: Box counts and yards-before-contact from FTN/participation are required (SCHEME); draft omitted it and added spurious DRAFT ('combine with expected rushes').

nfl.dvp.rationale: RULES is spurious ('slot' matched a keyword; ridge fit). Needs player target data, injury status and pbp.

nfl.coaching.rationale: VENUE spurious ('neutral pass rate'). Head-coach tenure is in schedule_results, but offensive/defensive coordinator history is NOT in any mapped dataset (needs staff/transaction history), so coordinator regimes are a missing need.
nfl.coaching.notes: head-coach part computable; coordinator history needs staff transactions

nfl.snaps.rationale: Snap share by down/distance/score state needs nfl.snap_counts (2012+) and per-play participation (2016+); nfl.player_stats_weekly has no snap data.

nfl.routes.rationale: RULES and DRAFT are spurious ('slot', 'combine'). Routes run/TPRR/YPRR per player need FTN charting (2022-2025 only) - participation lacks routes; history is four seasons.

nfl.targets.rationale: WEATHER_FCST is spurious ('targets forecast' is own projection). TPRR component needs route data (FTN 2022+).

nfl.carries.rationale: WEATHER_FCST spurious ('rush attempts forecast'). Carry/goal-line/passing-down role needs pbp and snap_counts.

nfl.rz_share.rationale: WEATHER_FCST spurious ('red-zone trip forecast'). Red-zone shares need pbp yardline_100.

nfl.td_rates.rationale: Expected team TDs = (team total - FG expectation)/7: the team total input must come from an own model (market totals are excluded), so this is derived from nfl.model_team_td_mean / own rating.

nfl.air_yards_adot.rationale: AWARDS and DRAFT are spurious ('honors', 'combine'). Real needs: pbp air yards, NGS/PFR depth data, observed wind. NGS aggregates end 2023.

nfl.catch_rate_oe.rationale: Catch rate over expected needs target depth/location/cp from nfl.pbp, which is not mapped (psw has no target-level fields).

nfl.rb_efficiency.rationale: DRAFT spurious ('combine with opponent run defense'). Yards after contact and broken tackles are PFR advanced stats (2018+), not mapped.

nfl.int_rate.rationale: Turnover-worthy/bad-throw and pressure decomposition needs PFR advanced stats (2018+) and pbp, not mapped.

nfl.divisional_familiarity.rationale: Definition regresses residuals vs spread/total (market-derived); only the division/first-meeting features are market-free. Hybrid, with a market benchmark component the draft treats as fully computable.

nfl.motivation_seeding.rationale: Marginal win value comes from the standings simulation (derived); depends_on nfl.standings_sim. NEWS (announced rest) legit.

nfl.team_total_split.rationale: raw_data uses spread_line, total_line and quoted team totals (own capture of market quotes); text says 'Benchmark only ... Label output as market-derived'. Market-derived benchmark missed by the draft.

nfl.standings_sim.rationale: Monte Carlo of remaining games uses team ratings with uncertainty (derived); depends_on own rating. RULES (tiebreakers) legit; remaining schedule from schedule_results.

nfl.schedule_strength.rationale: Opponent-adjusted remaining schedule strength is built from team ratings: derived input depends_on own rating; schedule from schedule_results.

nfl.bracket_path.rationale: Seed/bye/path probabilities are simulated from ratings and standings: derived from nfl.standings_sim and own rating.

nfl.season_to_date_pace.rationale: PROJECTIONS is spurious: 'opponent-adjusted projections' are own-model outputs, not published projection vintages. Derived from games_played_dist and own rating.

nfl.leader_order_statistic.rationale: Spurious AWARDS. The text says it simulates from player_stat_variance and games_played_dist: derived input.

nfl.fantasy_points_model.rationale: Bottom-up fantasy points need player-level yards/receptions/TDs (nfl.player_stats_weekly) and pbp; draft mapped only TEAM_BOX pbp. ff_opportunity is FREE_PATH_UNCONFIRMED so not relied on.

nfl.award_voting_mechanics.rationale: SCHEME and AVAIL are keyword accidents ('news and injury reports'). Needs ballot rules/timing documents, award results and announcements.

nfl.draft_board.rationale: DRAFT mapped to nfl.draft_combine (static picks/combine) but definition is draft order, prospect rankings with timestamp; dated boards are xx.draft_boards_vintaged (prospective).

nfl.futures_coherence.rationale: 'aggregate all active contracts per group; sum of implied midpoints' is Kalshi price-derived; CONTRACTS match is Kalshi contracts, not player contracts. Market-derived benchmark.

nfl.season_sim_distribution.rationale: NEWS spurious. Simulation from own ratings, QB injury hazards and tiebreakers: derived from own rating and standings_sim.

m.stat_correction_risk.rationale: Needs official stats at game end vs T+1d and T+7d: nflverse player_stats keeps only the final value, so game-end/T+7d vintages require own capture (new dataset); CONTRACTS spurious.

m.rules_text.rationale: Needs Kalshi rules_primary/secondary text per contract (mkt.kalshi_rules); WEATHER_OBS, EVENT, CONTRACTS are spurious. Version history for old series may be truncated (registry), so coarse.

m.lifecycle.rationale: AVAIL spurious ('status changes'). Lifecycle timestamps are Kalshi market metadata; history of halts/postponements is not preserved by metadata.

m.strike_hit_rates.rationale: Hit rate by price bucket and calibration (price vs realized) uses Kalshi prices: market-derived benchmark. PLAYER_BOX/CONTRACTS spurious.

nfl.leg_dependence_by_margin_regime.rationale: Bins on pregame spread (market) and total terciles; NEWS spurious ('report standard errors'). Sibling nfl.leg_dependence_by_model_regime is the market-free version, so this one is market-derived.

nfl.multi_td_dispersion.rationale: Raw uses xTD by game: derived from nfl.player_xtd.

nfl.zero_snap_active_risk.rationale: Needs game-day inactives (inactives by game) - nfl.inactives_game_day is prospective only - plus snap_counts; draft used weekly injuries and player_stats_weekly. Protected-void rules from Kalshi rules.

nfl.fourth_and_goal_policy.rationale: Fields down, ydstogo, yardline_100, wp, play_type are in nfl.pbp, not nfl.schedule_results (mapped).

nfl.common_availability_shock.rationale: NEWS spurious. Raw names injury report vintages and depth charts: injury_report_vintages (prospective) and depth_charts.

nfl.kickoff_rule_regime.rationale: Raw is pbp kickoff fields (kickoff_returner, kick_distance, touchback); only RULES was mapped, no pbp.

nfl.opening_kick_field_position.rationale: Raw is pbp kickoff fields; PLAYER_BOX player_stats_weekly cannot give kickoff field position. Needs pbp plus rule-regime reference.

nfl.rush_yardage_tail.rationale: Per-carry yardage tail needs pbp (rushing_yards per play) and defenders_in_box from participation; weekly aggregates cannot give per-carry yardage.

nfl.carry_count_forecast.rationale: Raw names an inactive list (nfl.inactives_game_day, prospective) and own pre-game margin (derived from nfl.own_team_rating_market_free).

nfl.lineup_adjusted_team_rating.rationale: Raw lists injury vintages, depth charts and snap counts; weekly injuries are final-of-week, so vintages are needed.

nfl.heteroskedastic_margin_sd.rationale: Raw needs model mean margin and total per game (own model, market-free) and backup-QB flag: derived.

nfl.deep_tail_margin_model.rationale: Raw: model mean margin and total per game; derived from own model.

nfl.rating_state_space.rationale: RULES spurious ('updating rule'). Needs pbp EPA only.

nfl.total_plays_state_model.rationale: VENUE spurious ('neutral pace'). Raw uses team neutral pace: derived from nfl.pace.

nfl.total_distribution_tail.rationale: Raw: model expected-total regime (market-free): derived from own team points model.

nfl.weather_total_response.rationale: Team baseline expected total is an own-model output (derived); forecast vintages come from env.weather_forecast_pit (2022+ only).

nfl.ot_total_increment.rationale: Raw uses own-model margin lattice per game: derived from nfl.model_margin_lattice.

nfl.event_calendar_hazard.rationale: Raw is an event log (date, team, person, type) - transactions/coaching events - which maps to no available dataset; draft mapped injuries/pbp and so called it free-measured. Needs transactions_news; contract status as-of vintages also not preserved.

nfl.initial_roster_cut_model.rationale: Raw needs preseason snaps (snap_counts/pbp have no preseason), contract guarantees as of cut day (cap table vintages not preserved) and injury status at cut: draft status/PIT too optimistic.

nfl.coach_exit_hazard.rationale: Preseason own rating is derived (depends_on own rating); exit dates/contract years need transactions.

nfl.draft_qb_class_model.rationale: Needs time-stamped consensus big boards (xx.draft_boards_vintaged), not nfl.draft_combine; team QB contract as-of vintage not preserved.

nfl.broadcast_role_assignment.rationale: OFFICIALS mapped nfl.officials (game referees) but need is broadcast network crew sheets and talent contract announcements, which no registry dataset holds. New own-capture dataset proposed.

nfl.injury_return_timeline.rationale: NEWS spurious ('injury reports'). Body part/status/practice by week with games missed is nfl.injuries_weekly (2009-2025) plus weekly stats; weekly granularity suffices for a return-time distribution.

nfl.designation_to_play_calibration.rationale: Needs practice status per day (intra-week sequence) which nfl.injuries_weekly does not preserve; requires injury_report_vintages. NEWS spurious.

nfl.healthy_inactive_base_rate.rationale: Raw: inactive list, injury report, snap counts. Inactive list history is nfl.inactives_game_day (prospective). NEWS spurious.

nfl.qb_change_hazard.rationale: Raw wants depth chart (nfl.depth_charts) not participation; backup contract as-of values are not preserved in contracts_cap (coarse).

nfl.snap_appearance_given_active.rationale: Raw is snap counts by player-game by unit (nfl.snap_counts), not weekly stats; the 'given active' denominator needs the active/inactive list.

nfl.depth_chart_publication_lag.rationale: Needs depth chart snapshots with publication timestamps: nfl.depth_charts is weekly and carries no publication time, so lag needs timestamped capture; participation mapped wrongly.

nfl.roster_designation_constraints.rationale: Roster status by date (IR/PUP/NFI/suspension) lives in nfl.rosters weekly statuses, not injuries_weekly.

nfl.qb_dropback_to_attempt_leakage.rationale: Raw includes pressure rate faced per defence from participation was_pressure; SCHEME not mapped.

nfl.red_zone_target_quality.rationale: AWARDS spurious. Raw names inactives at the as-of time (nfl.inactives_game_day prospective) and roster height/weight.

nfl.qb_blowout_pull_threshold.rationale: RULES spurious ('benching rule'). Backup identity needs depth chart; head coach from schedule_results.

nfl.receiving_corps_route_weighted_quali.rationale: Routes run by player-game need FTN (2022+); inactive lists with timestamps are prospective only.

nfl.own_rating_game_state_prior.rationale: Own-rating prior is derived from nfl.own_team_rating_market_free; raw names inactives for starting QB (inactives_game_day prospective).

nfl.with_without_target_redistribution.rationale: Raw names weekly inactive lists (prospective inactives_game_day) and team depth chart roles (depth_charts), not participation.

nfl.player_reception_length_distribution.rationale: Per-reception yards/air yards/YAC need pbp; player_stats_weekly has only weekly totals.

nfl.late_lead_clock_carry_yield.rationale: Raw is pbp (run_gap, score_differential, game_seconds_remaining); player_stats_weekly cannot supply those.

nfl.rush_explosive_tail_rate.rationale: 10+/20+ yard run rates need per-carry yards_gained from pbp, not weekly aggregates.

nfl.qb_scramble_yield_given_pressure.rationale: Raw uses participation was_pressure; SCHEME not mapped.

nfl.teammate_vote_split_penalty.rationale: Raw is AP vote shares by candidate-season: AWARDS dataset not mapped (ballot-level not public; only aggregate shares).

nfl.rookie_opportunity_and_draft_capital.rationale: AVAIL spurious ('starter status'). Raw names depth chart vintages (nfl.depth_charts) and snap_counts.

nfl.award_month_window_games.rationale: AWARDS spurious (window definition). Opponent adjustment is nfl.dvp (derived).

nfl.coach_surprise_vs_own_prior.rationale: Raw uses frozen own preseason ratings and standings simulation output: derived.

nfl.rest_of_season_stat_projection.rationale: PROJECTIONS and AWARDS spurious: own projection. Injury status vintages (injury_report_vintages) needed.

nfl.clinched_rest_starter_probability.rationale: Raw: snap counts by player-week and clinch flags (from standings sim).

nfl.rating_uncertainty_shared_error.rationale: Raw: pre-season ratings per team: derived from own rating.

nfl.qb_scenario_rating_drop.rationale: Depth chart rank of QB2 needs nfl.depth_charts (not participation); rating drop derived from QB efficiency.

nfl.head_to_head_leverage_games.rationale: Raw uses standings simulation output: derived from nfl.standings_sim.

nfl.full_strength_rating_vs_season_avera.rationale: Raw: starter snap participation (nfl.snap_counts) and own win-probability model: derived.

nfl.draft_first_pick_loser_race.rationale: Pick ownership table needs ownership with dates (xx.draft_boards_vintaged covers order/lottery); nfl.draft_combine only holds completed picks. Standings sim derived.

nfl.fourth_down_fg_decision_rate.rationale: Fields (down, ydstogo, yardline_100, play_type, field_goal_result, two_point_attempt) are pbp, not schedule_results.

nfl.team_score_pmf_own_mean.rationale: Raw uses own pregame expected team points: derived from nfl.model_team_points_mean.

nfl.sleeper_scoring_and_group_definition.rationale: Raw is Sleeper metadata/scoring settings and correction timing (value capture timestamps); nflverse pbp/weekly stats do not preserve correction vintages (own capture) and scoring settings are reference documents.

nfl.weekly_field_projection_grid.rationale: PROJECTIONS spurious (own grid). Raw names inactives (prospective) and game totals (derived from own model).

nfl.long_fg_attempt_and_make_model.rationale: Raw is pbp kick_distance/field_goal_result/kicker; no EVENT mapped.

nfl.streak_and_undefeated_hazard_path.rationale: Raw names outputs of nfl.standings_sim: derived.

nfl.defence_sack_count_decomposition.rationale: Pressure flags from vendors need participation was_pressure (2016+) / PFR; only TEAM_BOX mapped.

nfl.leg_dependence_by_model_regime.rationale: Raw: point-in-time model expected margin and total: derived from own models.

nfl.cross_league_futures_leg.rationale: Raw: NFL season simulation output and other-league title probabilities: derived (market futures benchmark).

nfl.cross_game_leg_dependence.rationale: Raw uses archived model p_home_win with as_of_ts: derived from own rating archive.

nfl.halftime_margin_scoring_model.rationale: Raw: point-in-time own model expected margin: derived.

nfl.pro_bowl_flag_roster_strength.rationale: Raw has replacement dates (timestamped news) and WR/TE yards per route run (FTN 2022+).

nfl.weather_delay_hazard.rationale: Weather delay records per game are in no mapped dataset (pbp does not flag delays); needs delay log (new manual dataset) and forecast vintages.

nfl.weekly_qb_depth_slot_model.rationale: RULES spurious. Raw: depth chart snapshots with publication dates, preseason snap counts by quarter (no preseason dataset), QB draft slot and contract APY (vintage not preserved).

nfl.hof_finalist_progression_history.rationale: CONTRACTS spurious ('class cap'). Needs Hall of Fame results and rules.

nfl.executive_move_attribution.rationale: Raw includes PFWA Executive of the Year winners (AWARDS not mapped) and head-coach change by season.

nfl.ol_individual_protection_record.rationale: Lineman pass-block snaps, pressures and sacks allowed are PFR advanced stats (2018+), not NGS aggregates.

nfl.multi_season_playoff_drought_hazard.rationale: AVAIL and RULES spurious. Season-end ratings are own ratings (derived); playoff qualification from results; draft pick positions legit.

nfl.kicker_ceiling_range_tail.rationale: Raw is pbp kick_distance/field_goal_result; schedule_results (mapped) has none. Preseason long-kick evidence listed.

nfl.play_length_evt_tail_fit.rationale: Raw is pbp yards_gained/yardline_100/kick_distance; mapped schedule_results lacks them.

nfl.td_play_length_by_source.rationale: Raw is pbp touchdown/return fields; mapped schedule_results lacks them.

nfl.scrimmage_turnover_return_long_tail.rationale: Raw is pbp return_yards/interception/fumble_lost; mapped schedule_results lacks them.

nfl.kicking_ball_and_fg_rule_era.rationale: Raw also needs pbp kick_distance/field_goal_result/desc; only RULES mapped.

nfl.preseason_long_kick_evidence.rationale: Needs preseason pbp (nfl.pbp is regular season/postseason only) plus dated warm-up reports; new dataset nfl.preseason_pbp proposed.

nfl.draft_pick_ownership_trade_graph.rationale: Pick ownership with trade dates is not in nfl.draft_combine (completed picks); ownership/order vintages are xx.draft_boards_vintaged.

nfl.prospect_slot_dispersion_model.rationale: Raw needs consensus rank at 90/30/1 days pre-draft: dated boards (xx.draft_boards_vintaged, prospective); final draft_combine cannot give them. RULES spurious.

nfl.team_positional_need_and_qb_regime.rationale: RULES spurious. Raw wants depth chart and contract years/cap hits as-of: cap table vintages are not preserved.

nfl.prospect_declaration_eligibility_med.rationale: AVAIL maps NFL weekly injuries but need is college injury log and declaration dates; needs dated news.

nfl.gm_draft_behavior_history.rationale: Needs historical consensus rank vs pick (draft boards, xx.draft_boards_vintaged) and GM tenure.

nfl.full_draft_order_compensatory_picks.rationale: Raw: free-agent signings/losses with contract values and forfeiture notices (transactions) -> missing NEWS; DRAFT order via dated source.

nfl.prospect_eligibility_clock_and_nil_e.rationale: AVAIL spurious. Needs NCAA eligibility rulings/dockets (news) and early-entry lists.

nfl.sb_neutral_site_matchup_win_prob.rationale: Raw names injury and depth chart vintages; own rating derived.

nfl.sb_mvp_depth_chart_position_map.rationale: Raw: depth chart listings per player at game time (nfl.depth_charts, weekly) and roster position; AWARDS/EVENT spurious.

nfl.combine_invite_pool_position_mix.rationale: Raw: invite_list with release_date (dated list), not just final combine results; needs timestamped news.

nfl.prospect_pre_combine_athletic_prior.rationale: WEATHER_OBS (NFL game weather) is wrong: wind refers to college track meets; track marks absent from registry; GPS reports are dated news.

nfl.combine_attempt_noise_best_of_k.rationale: Attempt-level forty_1/forty_2 and pro-day marks are not in nfl.draft_combine (final measurements).

nfl.combine_timing_protocol_and_venue.rationale: WEATHER_OBS/PLAYER_BOX spurious. Tracker snapshots with timestamps and release notes: timestamped capture.

nfl.slate_running_extreme_state.rationale: RULES/EVENT spurious. Needs game scores and rushing yards by game.

nfl.player_single_game_yardage_extreme_r.rationale: Own-model expected margin: derived; per-carry from pbp.

nfl.weekly_slate_composition.rationale: Raw is schedule only; use schedule_results (pbp TEAM_BOX and weather mapped wrongly).

nfl.season_extreme_era_base_rate.rationale: Raw needs game results 1978-2025 and single-game rushing leaders by season; nfl.schedule_results/pbp start 1999 (21 seasons short). New dataset proposed.

nfl.combo_shared_weather_leg_coupling.rationale: Own-model leg expectations: derived; forecast vintages only 2022+.

nfl.sibling_leg_marginal_interface.rationale: Simulation draw matrices from sibling models: derived. CONTRACTS spurious; needs injury/weather vintages, Kalshi rules.

nfl.fantasy_kicker_points_chain.rationale: NEWS spurious. Kicker active status by injury report vintage -> injury_report_vintages.

nfl.fantasy_dst_points_chain.rationale: NEWS spurious. Injury report vintages for QBs and edge rushers -> injury_report_vintages.

nfl.combine_vertical_jump_prior.rationale: WEATHER_OBS (NFL games) wrong for track jump marks; college track data absent.

nfl.player_single_game_stat_extreme_fami.rationale: AVAIL and OFFICIALS are keyword accidents ('game status', 'stat crew').

nfl.market_free_score_state_blowout_mass.rationale: Raw: own-model team ratings and drive rates: derived.

nfl.league_window_banked_count_and_expos.rationale: AVAIL spurious ('game status'). Raw: own-model team ratings: derived.

nfl.team_window_game_exposure.rationale: Needs own-capture of Kalshi listing time and as-of opponent QB distribution (derived).

nfl.window_hazard_survival_with_game_cor.rationale: Raw names ladder from nfl.team_window_game_exposure: derived.

registry_objections.objection: pit is STATIC but its own missingness says the vintage of the cap table at each past date is not preserved: contract/cap values used as-of a past date are FINAL_ONLY (look-ahead), so CONTRACTS-based inputs should not be rated PIT_SAFE.
hist starts 1999: inputs requiring game results before 1999 (e.g. nfl.season_extreme_era_base_rate asks 1978-2025) are not covered.
